chunks: And through its chain, from Ali (peace be upon him), he said:
The knowledge of the believer is the lost treasure of the believer.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of knowledge in Shia Islam according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) describes knowledge as the 'lost treasure' (dallat al-mu'min) of the believer, a metaphor rooted in the pre-Islamic and early Islamic practice of marking camels to prevent loss, thereby highlighting knowledge as the believer's most vital and enduring asset. This hadith underscores the Shia emphasis on 'Ilm not merely as information, but as the spiritual compass that guides the believer through life's uncertainties and preserves their faith.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-296 According to the same documentation, on the authority of Ali (a.s.),
“A believer seeks knowledge as hard as he would seek his lost ones.”
